entries.04716972b1afe8ad: This business operates convenience stores, centered on 7-Eleven, Inc., in North America, Australia, China and other regions, under both directly operated and franchise systems. Directly operated stores sell processed foods, fast food, daily-delivered foods, and non-food products, and also sell gasoline to visiting customers and dealers. From franchisees, it receives royalties based on each store’s gross profit, as consideration for a bundled set of services comprising trademark and other licensing, training, pre-opening preparation, advertising, management guidance, and licensing of land, buildings and equipment.
entries.07d437c78da7c915: Licensing of business know-how and trademarks to franchise stores and provision of accounting and bookkeeping services, among other services
entries.5291b5946ff06b65: This is a business segment not included in the reportable segments, and it includes the specialty store business and real estate business, among others. SpireX Co., Ltd., Terube Co., Ltd. and Seven & i Energy Management Co., Ltd. belong to it as consolidated subsidiaries, and Tower Records Japan Co., Ltd. and Pia Co., Ltd. are affiliates.
entries.72559e38dbf83def: This business engages in banking, credit card, electronic money and leasing operations, among others, and earns revenue from fees received for providing each service. Seven Bank, Ltd., which had been at its core, was removed from the scope of consolidation on June 24, 2025, after it participated in the bank's repurchase of its own shares, and became an equity-method affiliate.
entries.96029117d8b420ce: This is a retail business that comprehensively supplies food and daily necessities, consisting of the GMS (general merchandise store) business and the supermarket business. The core operating companies, Ito-Yokado Co., Ltd. and York-Benimaru Co., Ltd., among others, were transferred to York Holdings Co., Ltd. (formerly BCJ-96 Co., Ltd.) through an absorption-type company split completed on September 1, 2025, and because the company's equity stake in BCJ-95 Co., Ltd., the parent of York Holdings, became 35.07%, this business was removed from the scope of consolidation and became subject to the equity method.
entries.9d8523c8876dbe8d: This business operates convenience stores in Japan under company-operated and franchise models, centered on Seven-Eleven Japan Co., Ltd. To franchised stores, it provides as a single inseparable service the licensing of business know-how and trademarks, equipment leasing, purchasing cooperation, advertising, management consulting, credit for merchandise purchases, pre-opening support, training, and accounting and bookkeeping services, and it receives royalties according to each store's gross profit.
entries.aa580e6aa742fa50: Trademark licensing, management guidance and equipment licensing for franchisees
entries.ca987b8022adcefb: A holding company of a corporate group operating the convenience store "Seven-Eleven", mainly in Japan and North America.
